jobs.description:
We are currently seeking full-time warehouse employees for our new, state-of-the-art distribution center in Oss. This is a long-term position with excellent opportunities for career growth in a dynamic and multicultural environment. Important! This is a physically active role. Lifting crates and materials up to 25 kg is part of the job. Flexibility and a good work ethic are essential! What’s your job about? Inbound: Receive incoming goods from truck drivers. This is not a physically demanding role. CPS (Continuous Packing System): Perform voice picking and operate an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT). While previous experience is preferred, no certifications are required. This role may involve physically demanding tasks depending on the products handled. DPS (Direct Picking System): Similar to pick-to-light systems, products will be delivered to your station. The role requires working efficiently under time pressure but is not physically demanding. The department is located at a higher level in the distribution center, so comfort with heights is essential. Outbound: Organize trolleys and dollies for pick-up. Attention to detail is crucial to ensure products are delivered to the correct locations. This role can be physically demanding, particularly when handling heavier items such as alcohol and cigarettes. Emballage: Manage and recycle empty packaging materials such as bottles, crates, and cans. You will also check trolleys for reuse. This role may involve physically demanding tasks based on the materials handled. You must be flexible, ready to work on each department. What skills do you have? Good command of the English language. Previous experience in logistics and the ability to handle heavier loads (up to 20 kg). Flexibility to work in shifts and willingness to work overtime or weekends when necessary. You are ready to driver EPT. What do you get in return? Travel Allowance: €0.21 per km, up to a maximum of 10,50 km per day. 16,33 EUR/gross per hour + holiday

allowance (8.33%) = 17,69 EUR brutto/h Shift allowance Modern Work Environment. Multicultural Team: Join a diverse and inclusive work environment. Personal Development Opportunities: We offer ongoing training and opportunities for career advancement. A beautiful cheap canteen where you can grab a good breakfast/lunch/dinner for a good price.

Do you want to help develop innovative therapies for lung cancer and mesothelioma? Join an international research team and contribute to cutting-edge preclinical cancer research. Lung cancer and mesothelioma remain among the deadliest cancers worldwide, highlighting the need for more effective and targeted therapies. Our research focuses on developing innovative treatments by targeting the RNA splicing machinery, a promising therapeutic strategy for cancers with a high unmet medical need. In this project, which runs until the end of 2028, you will contribute to preclinical laboratory research using advanced disease models, including patient-derived organoids and human xenograft tumour models on chicken eggs. You will also investigate why cancer cells are particularly sensitive to disruption of the RNA splicing machinery. Your work will directly contribute to the development of new treatment strategies for patients with lung cancer and mesothelioma. As a Research Technician, you will play an important role in the day-to-day execution of this research project. You will work closely with researchers to generate high-quality experimental data and contribute to innovative cancer research. Your responsibilities include: planning, preparing and performing molecular and cellular laboratory experiments; working with patient-derived organoids, xenograft tumour models and gene delivery, expression and gene silencing techniques; documenting, processing and analysing experimental data; preparing study reports and maintaining accurate laboratory records; presenting research findings during internal meetings and contributing to scientific collaborations.
